name: SaaS CRM Platform
prompt: Build a B2B CRM SaaS platform with multi-tenant support, contact management, deal pipeline, email integration, and reporting dashboard. Target market: SMB sales teams of 5-50 people.

name: Real-time Multiplayer Game Backend
prompt: Design the backend for a real-time multiplayer strategy game supporting 10,000 concurrent users per game room, WebSocket connections, game state synchronization, matchmaking, leaderboards, and anti-cheat mechanisms.

name: Healthcare Patient Portal
prompt: Build a HIPAA-compliant patient portal for a medical clinic. Features: appointment scheduling, secure messaging with providers, medical record viewing, prescription refills, telehealth video calls, and billing/insurance integration.

name: E-commerce Marketplace
prompt: Create a multi-vendor e-commerce marketplace similar to Etsy. Features: seller onboarding, product listings with variants, cart and checkout with Stripe, order management, seller payouts, reviews, and search with filters.

name: Developer Tools API Gateway
prompt: Design an API gateway product for developers: rate limiting, authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT), request routing, response caching, analytics, webhook management, and a developer portal with documentation.

name: Simple Todo App
prompt: Build a simple personal todo app with task creation, completion tracking, due dates, and tags. Single user, no collaboration needed.

name: AI Content Generation Platform
prompt: Build an AI-powered content generation platform: users input a topic and tone, the system generates blog posts, social media captions, and email copy using LLMs. Features: history, templates, brand voice settings, and team collaboration.

name: IoT Fleet Management
prompt: Design a fleet management platform for IoT devices: device registration and provisioning, real-time telemetry ingestion (10M events/day), alerting rules, OTA firmware updates, device grouping, and historical analytics.

name: Event Ticketing System
prompt: Build an event ticketing platform: event creation, tiered ticket types, seat selection, QR code generation for tickets, barcode scanning for entry, waitlist management, and refund processing.

name: Financial Portfolio Tracker
prompt: Create a personal finance portfolio tracker: connect brokerage accounts via OAuth, fetch holdings and transactions, calculate performance metrics (IRR, TWRR), tax lot tracking, dividend tracking, and rebalancing suggestions.
